display.title: Episode 348: Little Avraham Finds Hashem
display.summary_short: Letters pour in about houses turned into a mitzvah, two sisters lead the Shema, little Avraham searches for the Creator, and the hidden secrets of the word Echad.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the week of Parshas Lech Lecha 5749. Uncle Yossi's mailbox is full of letters about last week's project of fixing a tzedakah pushka to the wall, and he reads one from a girl in Far Rockaway who nailed the pushka up with her parents and now feels Hashem is a welcome guest in her home; she wins a gift certificate. After the Hakochainik march, two sisters from Beis Rivkah lead the Shema. Story time tells of little Avraham, only three years old, walking by the sea and wondering who made the world. He thinks the sun might be God until it sets, then the moon, then the stars, until he understands that the one God, unseen and everywhere, created them all, and he grows up to teach the world about Hashem. Uncle Yossi then reveals the secrets of the word Echad: Aleph for Hashem, the Master of the world; Ches, eight, for the seven heavens and the earth; and Daled for the four directions. Everyone sings 'Hashem is here, Hashem is there', and the show ends with Shabbos candle time.
display.lesson: Hashem is one, unseen but everywhere, and when we say 'Echad' in the Shema we remember that He fills the heavens, the earth and all four corners of the world.

date.note: Consistent with the audio: Shabbos candles on Friday 28 October; the Avraham story suits the week of Parshas Lech Lecha.
